title: BELT: SELECTED GRENADE AND HEAL RINGED IN GOLD
why: His note of 2026-10-13: "selected throwables/heals should be outlined in gold just like the selected gun is". The gold ring the belt draws round the gun in hand is now also drawn round the grenade G throws and the heal H uses, in the same colour, width and corner, so up to three keys wear it at once: the gun in hand, the chosen grenade and the chosen heal. The ring follows U and J, and a click on a grenade or heal key. The other grenade, the other heal, the plate and a key with nothing on it get no ring, and the keycaps are unchanged. The Undercroft floor belt keeps the gun ring alone.
now: The belt now rings the chosen grenade and the chosen heal in gold, like the gun in hand.
